# Industrial Coating Insurance

> Industrial Coating Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability Insurance for Industrial Coating Contractors, Contractors Pollution Liability for Industrial Coating Contractors, Professional Liability (E&O) for Industrial Coating Contractors, Workers' Compensation for Industrial Coating Contractors, Commercial Auto for Industrial Coating Contractors, Tools & Equipment Floater for Industrial Coating Contractors, Umbrella / Excess Liability for Industrial Coating Contractors, Builders Risk / Installation Floater for Industrial Coating Contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
